title: How Can You Respond with Love When There is Chaos and Political Upheaval All Around You?
fullTitle: Soul Feast #45: How Can You Respond with Love When There is Chaos and Political Upheaval All Around You?
description: Are you making choices in love or fear? Take this self-assessment today to find out.

When the world feels like it’s unraveling – filled with political upheaval, social disintegration, and emotional overwhelm – how can you stay centered in love? In this episode, Gary Zukav answers a deeply relevant question: How can I respond with love when everything around me feels chaotic?
It does not come from the pursuit of external power, but through emotional awareness and responsible choice.

He explains that we are living in a historic transformation – from the old consciousness rooted in fear, manipulation, and control – to a new consciousness based in love, gratitude, and aligning your personality with your soul. In the midst of chaos, we’re invited to look inward, become aware of the frightened parts of our personality, and consciously choose to respond from a loving part. This choice is not just spiritual rhetoric – it’s the creation of authentic power and the path to personal and collective healing.

Creating authentic power doesn’t require the world to calm down first. In fact, the outer world often activates the inner work that is necessary for your soul’s growth. When you use your emotional awareness to feel the painful physical sensations of fear in your energy centers, you see that a frightened part of your personality is active. That is a signal. It is a point of choice. By making the responsible choice to respond with love in that moment, you become an empowered creator of your life, not a victim of your circumstances.
What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

(01:34) — The Rise of a New Consciousness: Why this transformation is unlike anything humanity has experienced before (04:52) — Old vs. New Power: How control and manipulation are now toxic, and how soul-alignment is the new strength (06:44) — Why Changing the World Doesn’t Work: The truth about external power and the inner shift that truly matters (09:50) — Reading Your Body’s Signals: How energy processing centers reveal whether fear or love is active within you (12:15) — Mastering the Moment: What it really means to respond from love—and how to keep choosing it, again and again (17:40) — The Most Powerful Place to Look Is Within: Why your inner world holds more power than anything outside of you

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge: This week, notice when the world around you feels chaotic or overwhelming. Instead of reacting, pause. Feel into your energy centers—your throat, chest, and solar plexus. What physical sensations are present? Is fear active? What thoughts are surfacing? Then, shift your awareness to a loving part of your personality. Remember a moment of deep love or appreciation, and let that energy guide your response.
This is how you create authentic power—through emotional awareness and responsible choice, one moment at a time.
